description: Start here. Diagnose one sanitized MCP, API, webhook, agent or integration failure for free. Returns bounded evidence plus a suggested repair service, then use quote_repair only if a priced repair is wanted. It never creates a quote, checkout, payment or repair job. It may record bounded operational attribution/telemetry, so readOnlyHint is false; it does not modify the caller system or commercial state.

problem.description: One sanitized technical symptom. Include the affected component and observable error/status. Never include secrets, credentials, private keys or PII.

source.description: Optional attribution label for the calling agent or integration; omit when no stable source label is available.

name: diagnose_issue

outputSchema.description: Bounded diagnosis result. On success phase is DIAGNOSE and nextTool is quote_repair; an error field indicates diagnosis was unavailable.

automaticCheckout.description: False; diagnosis never creates checkout automatically.

automaticExecution.description: False; diagnosis never starts repair execution.

automaticPayment.description: False; diagnosis never sends or charges payment.

automaticQuote.description: False; diagnosis never creates a quote automatically.

error.description: Present when a bounded diagnosis could not be produced.

free.description: True for this free diagnostic step.

nextTool.description: quote_repair when the caller wants a priced bounded repair.

phase.description: DIAGNOSE on a successful bounded diagnosis.

rawInputStored.description: False when the raw diagnostic input is not retained as payload data.

suggestedProductId.description: Public repair product suggested from the diagnosis when available.

title: Diagnose Issue
